title: Link
summary: A router-aware text link: a real anchor in prose or a nav row, with href for an ordinary address or to for an app route the app router handles without a full page load.

props.name: href
props.description: An external or same-document address. Navigates natively (middle and ctrl-click, the status-bar URL). Ignored when to is set.

props.name: to
props.description: A module-relative route. A plain click is intercepted and reported as a cancelable pk-navigate for the app router (js/router.js mountRouter, mounted with mountApp) to handle; a modified click (middle, ctrl, shift, alt), target or download, or a router that does not cancel the event, falls back to a normal navigation.

props.name: target
props.description: Where the link opens (for example _blank). _blank adds rel="noopener noreferrer" automatically and a visually hidden "(opens in a new tab)" after the label.

props.name: rel
props.description: The link relation. Defaults to noopener noreferrer when target is _blank.

props.name: download
props.description: Downloads the target instead of opening it, under the file name given (the bare attribute keeps the name from the URL).

props.name: current
props.description: Marks the link as the current page: sets aria-current="page" on the anchor.

props.name: variant
props.description: inline is a coloured, underlined prose link; muted is a quiet reference (a nav row, a card footer); plain keeps the surrounding text colour.

slots.description: The link text. No decorative glyph belongs inside it (#315); put an icon before or after the element instead.

events.name: pk-navigate
events.description: A plain click on a to link, before any navigation. Cancelable: the app router calls preventDefault and handles it; if nothing cancels the event pk-link falls back to a normal navigation to to.

parts.name: tab
parts.description: The visually hidden "(opens in a new tab)" text, shown only when target is _blank.

a11y: A real <a> lives in the shadow root (exposed as a link, works with no JS), with a visible focus ring. current sets aria-current="page" for the current page in a trail or nav list. An external link that opens in a new tab (target set to _blank) adds a visually hidden "(opens in a new tab)" after the label, so its accessible name still says where it leads without a decorative icon inside the link box.

examples.title: Inline prose link
examples.html: Read the routing guide before wiring the app shell.

examples.title: Current page and a new tab
examples.html:
<pk-link href="/orders" current>Orders</pk-link>
<pk-link href="https://example.com/help" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Help centre</pk-link>
